GitHub mitcad/Mitcad#741's first design (mitcad#2582; opened with --open, never committed; tools/cli/fillet-whole-rims-reported-test.cmake): a cylinder 10 across and 10 high (Extrude1 F5, Body1 F5.b0) whose end rim Fillet1 (F6, d3 = 5 mm) rounds with the cylinder's own radius. Built before 0.1 % smaller with a warning that it leaves a sliver of the end face; now a hemisphere of 5 tangent to the cylinder's other half, the other end flat, 250 pi - 125 / 3 pi, without a note.
